title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics & parity, version bump v1.56.0
author: Asha Patel
description: Summary: This PR consolidates recent ergonomics and parity fixes across the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs: a unified auth/retries behavior, improved streaming API ergonomics, and coordinated version bumps to v1.56.0. Motivation: downstream customers and internal integrations expect consistent retry behavior across SDKs and smoother streaming ergonomics (single-API streaming hook, better cancellation signals). Parity fixes address gaps surfaced by the integration test harness and community reports. This change prepares the SDKs for the next platform release and reduces support friction. Changes include: - Python: new Auth session wrapper to unify token refresh + retry logic, streaming generator helpers that yield typed chunk objects, tests added for backpressure/cancellation. - TypeScript: align retry backoff defaults with Python, add convenience onChunk callback + async iterator parity, update docs and examples. - Go: exported RetryPolicy struct and helper client constructor with sane defaults, streaming refactor to return channel + context cancellation support. - Docs: single SDK migration guide and changelogs updated. CI & QA: added cross-SDK integration tests in the eval-harness job; unit tests added for each SDK. Checklist: - [x] API review with SDK leads - [x] Integration tests passing in CI - [x] Docs updated - [x] Version bumps in each SDK package.json/go.mod/setup.py. Commits summary: squash commit that combines multiple authors' work into feature branch. Notable commits: "python: auth+retry wrapper; streaming generator". Review conversation highlights: "Ethan Liu: please confirm backoff math matches Go defaults; addressed in commit 7f9a2ed." "Lena Novak: minor docs nits; addressed." "Miguel Torres: approved after added integration test for cancellation edge-case." CI: all checks passed after rebased on main; eval-harness integration job exercised Python/TS/Go cross-client flows. Merge: squash merged to main via web UI. Release notes: "SDKs: unified auth+retry behavior, streaming ergonomics improved, parity fixes across Python/TS/Go. Version bumped to v1.56.0."
